name: InfraGuard Multi-Cloud Security Baseline v1
description: Deterministic security baseline containing 25 rules across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

rules.title: S3 Public Read Access
rules.description: Detect S3 bucket policies that explicitly permit public read access.

rules.title: S3 Public Write Access
rules.description: Detect S3 bucket policies that permit public write access.

rules.title: S3 Block Public Access Missing or Disabled
rules.description: Detect missing or explicitly disabled S3 Block Public Access settings.

rules.title: Internet-Wide SSH Ingress (Port 22)
rules.description: Detect security groups allowing unrestricted ingress on port 22.

rules.title: Internet-Wide RDP Ingress (Port 3389)
rules.description: Detect security groups allowing unrestricted ingress on port 3389.

rules.title: Overly Permissive Inbound Network Rules
rules.description: Detect ingress rules permitting unrestricted traffic on all protocols or all ports.

rules.title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible
rules.description: Detect RDS instances configured with public accessibility enabled.

rules.title: RDS Storage Encryption Disabled
rules.description: Detect RDS instances where storage encryption is explicitly disabled or omitted.

rules.title: EBS Volume Encryption Disabled
rules.description: Detect EBS volumes where encryption is explicitly disabled or omitted.

rules.title: Overly Broad IAM Permissions (Wildcard Action & Resource)
rules.description: Detect IAM policies granting wildcard actions and resources in Allow statements.

rules.title: S3 Bucket Server Access Logging Disabled
rules.description: Detect S3 buckets without explicit access logging configured.

rules.title: Storage Account Allows Public Blob Access
rules.description: Detect Azure storage accounts where public blob or nested item access is allowed.

rules.title: NSG Inbound SSH Exposed to Internet (Port 22)
rules.description: Detect Azure Network Security Groups allowing internet-wide inbound SSH on port 22.

rules.title: NSG Inbound RDP Exposed to Internet (Port 3389)
rules.description: Detect Azure Network Security Groups allowing internet-wide inbound RDP on port 3389.

rules.title: Storage Account Secure Transfer Disabled
rules.description: Detect Azure storage accounts that allow unencrypted HTTP traffic.

rules.title: Storage Account Infrastructure Encryption Missing
rules.description: Detect Azure storage accounts without double infrastructure encryption enabled.

rules.title: NSG Overly Permissive Inbound Traffic
rules.description: Detect inbound rules allowing all protocols and all ports from any internet source.

rules.title: Azure Database Public Network Access Enabled
rules.description: Detect Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, or MySQL servers with public network access enabled.

rules.title: Cloud Storage Public IAM Access
rules.description: Detect Cloud Storage IAM bindings that grant access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.

rules.title: GCP Firewall SSH Exposed to Internet (Port 22)
rules.description: Detect Google Cloud VPC firewall ingress rules permitting port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: GCP Firewall RDP Exposed to Internet (Port 3389)
rules.description: Detect Google Cloud VPC firewall ingress rules permitting port 3389 from 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: GCP Firewall Overly Permissive Ingress
rules.description: Detect firewall ingress rules allowing all traffic or all protocols from 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: Cloud Storage Uniform Bucket-Level Access Disabled
rules.description: Detect Cloud Storage buckets where uniform bucket-level access is not enabled.

rules.title: Cloud Storage Public Access Prevention Missing
rules.description: Detect Cloud Storage buckets where public access prevention is not set to 'enforced'.

rules.title: Overly Broad GCP Project IAM Role Grants
rules.description: Detect project IAM bindings granting broad or primitive roles to public principals.
